page.overview:
Who is Heat Protection King?

The was one of a trio of demons who impersonated Buddhas to steal fragrant oil from Gold Average Prefecture.

The Heat Protection King had round eyes, two massive horns, pointed ears, and hooves made of jade. He wore thin red gauze and a large brocade with floral designs.
